survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: The Survey of Adult Skills 2023 – Lithuania country notes report results for adults aged 16–65 in Lithuania, using a household survey design with a personal interview and a self-completed digital assessment on tablets. The sample was drawn to be representative of about 1.8 million adults aged 16–65 residing in Lithuania, and analyses were conducted to ensure that non-response would not introduce significant bias. The notes report an overall response rate of 44% and a final participation count of 6,186 adults, but they do not specify the exact survey weight variable names or whether replicate weights (e.g., BRR/jackknife) were used. Because this is a descriptive country-note report rather than a student-level ML modeling paper, the document does not provide a PV or missing-data modeling workflow; therefore, weighting details are not operationalized beyond the stated representativeness and non-response bias checks.

data.outcome_summary: The OECD Survey of Adult Skills 2023 – Lithuania country notes summarize adult proficiency in three domains—literacy, numeracy, and adaptive problem solving—assessed in 2022–23 among adults aged 16–65. Lithuania’s mean performance is below the OECD average in all three domains (238 literacy, 246 numeracy, 230 adaptive problem solving on 500-point scales). The report provides proficiency-level distributions (e.g., 38% at Level 1 or below in literacy; 32% at or below Level 1 in numeracy; 46% at or below Level 1 in adaptive problem solving) and compares results to OECD averages and selected comparison countries. It also documents changes over time versus 2014–15, reporting declines in literacy and numeracy and shifts toward lower proficiency levels. Associations with economic and social outcomes are described (e.g., a one-standard-deviation increase in numeracy proficiency relates to higher labour-force participation and higher wages), but the note does not specify an ML modeling pipeline, plausible-values combining rules, or missing-data handling for an ML analysis.
